title: Omar Feels Better
setting: A hospital room and a gym in the same town.

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a green T-shirt

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: Doctor Nina, a young woman doctor with long brown hair and a white coat

sentences.en: Omar wakes up and feels really tired.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔醒来，觉得真的很累。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a green T-shirt sits up in bed, yawning and rubbing his eyes.

sentences.en: He goes to see a doctor at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 于是他去医院找医生看病。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a green T-shirt walks into a bright hospital entrance.

sentences.en: The doctor checks his nose and his tooth.
sentences.zh: 医生检查了他的鼻子和牙齿。
sentences.scene_prompt: Doctor Nina, a young woman doctor with long brown hair and a white coat looks at the nose and teeth of Omar, a young man with short black hair and a green T-shirt with a small light.

sentences.en: "You eat too much sugar," the doctor says.
sentences.scene_prompt: Doctor Nina, a young woman doctor with long brown hair and a white coat points to a bowl of sugar and sweets while Omar, a young man with short black hair and a green T-shirt looks guilty.

sentences.en: Walking is good for your body, too.
sentences.zh: 散步对你的身体也有好处。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a green T-shirt walks briskly along a park path.

sentences.en: Now Omar loves going to the gym.
sentences.zh: 现在奥马尔爱上了去健身房。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a green T-shirt lifts light weights happily in a gym.

sentences.en: He is thirsty, so he drinks lots of water.
sentences.zh: 他口渴了，所以喝了很多水。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a green T-shirt drinks from a big water bottle in the gym, sweating.

sentences.en: After good food, he relaxes and feels wonderful.
sentences.zh: 吃了健康的饭菜后，他放松下来，感觉好极了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a green T-shirt relaxes on a sofa with a smile after a meal of salad and fish.
